# Virtual Labor Force & Forge_OS

> Virtual Labor Force builds and deploys pre-configured, local AI hardware appliances pre-loaded with Forge_OS for businesses and entrepreneurs in the Detroit Metro area (Oakland, Macomb, Wayne County).

## Core Offering: Owned Intelligence Hardware Nodes
- Philosophy: "Stop Renting Your Business Brain." Eliminates monthly SaaS subscriptions by bringing local AI execution directly onto physical hardware on the customer's desk.
- Operating System: Forge_OS (Browser-native, local-first agentic OS running on Pop!_OS Linux).

## Hardware & OS Product Matrix
1. Forge_OS Standalone License ($297 - $497 one-time): Software installation script and license for existing NVIDIA/Linux hardware.
2. Tier 1 - Spark Small Appliance ($1,499 retail / $997 pioneer pre-order): Compact PC, NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12GB VRAM), 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe. Designed for solo entrepreneurs and small offices.
3. Tier 2 - Workhorse Workstation ($3,299 one-time): Mid-Tower Workstation, NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24GB VRAM) or RTX 4080, 64GB DDR5 RAM, 2TB SSD. Designed for active trade businesses (plumbing, HVAC, electrical).
4. Tier 3 - Enterprise Command Station ($8,999 one-time): Dual RTX 3090 (48GB VRAM) / RTX 4090, 128GB RAM, 4TB NVMe. Designed for multi-location businesses.
